newsitem.title: THAILAND: Two injured in bomb blast at Bangkok IBM building.
newsitem.headline: Two injured in bomb blast at Bangkok IBM building.

text.p: At least two people were seriously injured on Thursday when a bomb exploded in the IBM building in central Bangkok, police said.
Police said the blast took place in a second floor parking lot of the building. They said about five cars were damaged by the incident.
The explosion came one day after a hand grenade was thrown into the compound of the residence of former foreign minister and national intelligence chief Prasong Soonsiri. He was not injured.
Prasong, a strong critic of Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh, accused the government of being behind the blast. The government denied the charge.
